examples.en: I will give you a gift.
I go to school every day.
Put your bag on the table.
What do you want to do?
I do my homework every day.
I will send you a letter.

meaning: 语言；语言文字；表达能力

examples.en: I read a book every day.
I go to school by bus.
The sun rises in the east.

meaning: 准备好的；现成的；乐意的
规则的；有规律的；常规的

examples.en: The sad story made me cry.
examples.cn: 这个悲伤的故事让我哭了。
